text: apply button still is half-baked. i click apply and it sometimes works sometimes doesnt work
resolution: Fixed the flaky building material Apply path. The button was applying through the target captured by the React render, so if the active face target moved via stage click/face chip before the material lens re-rendered, Apply could write the old target or silently no-op. Added a store-level applyPaintTargetSkin() that always reads the current paintTarget at click time, switched the material lens Apply/double-click path to use it, and added a regression proving Apply hits the current clicked face while leaving the stale roof target alone. Verified workbench/buildings 22/22 and hmsc-int bundle.
